sense: to make something fall into pieces

pins.definition: To damage something hard so that it separates into pieces or stops working.
To separate or make something separate into pieces suddenly or by force; to fail to keep a promise or rule.
To damage a solid object or machine so that it splits into pieces or stops working.

situation: A man in an old workshop has accidentally dropped a heavy porcelain plate on a stone floor, shattering it.
subject: the shattered pieces
brief: A white porcelain plate lies in dozens of sharp, scattered fragments across a grey stone floor, with fine ceramic dust catching the light. The man stands frozen above them with his empty hands still held out in shock.
prompt: A white porcelain plate lies in dozens of sharp, scattered fragments across a grey stone floor, with fine ceramic dust catching the light. The man stands frozen above them with his empty hands still held out in shock. thick impasto oil on canvas, visible loaded brushwork and palette-knife ridges, deep varnish tones, old-master lighting.
